inputs.label: Spend at least each month's income
Yearly shock SD of log(1 + inflation)
Inflation in the year before the as-of date
Person 1: Survivor budget factor when this person survives (empty = household default)
Person 2: Survivor budget factor when this person survives (empty = household default)
Social Security: First month no longer paid (empty = no end)
Social Security: Share paid after the recipient's death
UK State Pension: First month paid
UK State Pension: First month no longer paid (empty = no end)
UK State Pension: Rises with inflation
UK State Pension: Share paid after the recipient's death
NHS Pension: First month no longer paid (empty = no end)
NHS Pension: Share paid after the recipient's death
Person 1: age at the as-of date
Person 2: age at the as-of date

section.meaning: model, portfolio, budget, inflation, mortality, people, income or derived

item.meaning: Where the value lives in the config, e.g. budget.monthly_amount_today

value.meaning: The exact value used: numbers unrounded, dates ISO, lists separated by ;

unit.meaning: The value's unit; for run.seed, whether the seed came from the config or was generated

year.meaning: The row's year; the first and last rows can be partial years

probability_both_alive.meaning: Both people alive at year end (the row's last simulated month)

probability_person_1_alive.meaning: The first person under people alive at year end

probability_person_2_alive.meaning: The second person under people alive at year end

monthly_budget_nominal_median.meaning: Median over all paths of budget x inflation index at year end

annual_budget_nominal_median.meaning: Median Required Spending in the year (survivor factor applied), over paths still running in the year

annual_income_median.meaning: Median income received in the year, same paths

annual_net_withdrawal_median.meaning: Median of spending minus income in the year, same paths

portfolio_p05.meaning: 5th percentile of the year-end balance over paths where someone is alive

portfolio_p25.meaning: 25th percentile of that balance (paths that ran out count as 0)

probability_not_depleted_yet.meaning: The money has not run out by year end

estimated_lifetime_success_rate.meaning: Of the paths not yet out of money at year end, the share that turn out Successful

completed_paths.meaning: Paths settled by year end: the money ran out, or both people have died

monthly_budget_today.meaning: The configured budget behind the success columns

annual_return.meaning: The configured fixed return behind the success columns

target_probability.meaning: Target conservative success rate for this row

conservative_success_probability.meaning: Conservative success rate: successful / all paths

standard_error.meaning: Monte Carlo standard error of the conservative rate (denominator: all paths)

required_annual_return.meaning: Lowest fixed return meeting the target at this budget, rounded up to 1e-6; empty if none in range

converged.meaning: Whether the return search settled inside its bounds

iterations.meaning: Engine runs used by the return search

note.meaning: Why a row has no solution or sits at the lower bound; otherwise empty

target_probability.meaning: Target conservative success rate for this row

maximum_monthly_budget_today.meaning: Largest budget meeting the target, rounded down to 0.01; empty if infeasible

estimated_success_probability.meaning: Conservative success rate at that budget, from a confirming run

standard_error.meaning: Its Monte Carlo standard error (denominator: all paths)

unresolved_fraction.meaning: Paths never out of money with someone alive at the horizon, at that budget

converged.meaning: Whether the search settled below its 1,000,000 GBP/month cap

iterations.meaning: Engine runs used by the budget search

note.meaning: Why a row is infeasible or capped; otherwise empty

end_reserve_months.meaning: The End-of-Life Reserve R: R x the budget, inflated, must remain at the second death

target_probability.meaning: Target conservative success rate for this row

maximum_monthly_budget_today.meaning: Largest budget meeting the target, rounded down to 0.01; empty if infeasible

estimated_success_probability.meaning: Rate meeting the reserve target at that budget, from a confirming run

standard_error.meaning: Its Monte Carlo standard error (denominator: all paths)

unresolved_fraction.meaning: Paths never out of money with someone alive at the horizon, at that budget

converged.meaning: Whether the search settled below its 1,000,000 GBP/month cap

iterations.meaning: Engine runs used by the budget search

note.meaning: Why a row is infeasible or capped; otherwise empty
